all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: every version binding and admission re-derives byte for byte from its own published fields: each id is the digest of the record's body and each hash covers the record, with no clock or random draw on the decided path, so replaying a call reproduces the receipt; the deterministic leakage-audit id keeps even the embedded S05 audit replayable

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: every snapshot, partition, holdout and boundary identity is re-derived through the K05 function that owns it, the O05 lane receipt validates against its canonical schema, the S05 firewall's sealed evaluator bundle hash is bound verbatim, and each FINDING_CODE names an exact refusal

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: the three invariant refusals carry the weight — a stale evidence/holdout version, a hidden-holdout exposure, and evaluator feedback intersecting the holdout — each exercised from more than one angle, including a lying firewall that reports the holdout reachable; the gate re-verifies rather than trusts the composed surface, and the happy path still replays deterministically

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: nothing here scores, promotes or evaluates; a candidate, mutation-model, prompt or backend surface that can reach the hidden holdout is refused by path, a live probe proves no candidate-generating role may read the holdout, and the gate surfaces the sealed S05 refusal instead of re-qualifying around it

gate_semantics.binds: one re-derivable evidence/holdout version over the K05 snapshot bytes, the concealed partition, the holdout manifest, the S05 evaluator bundle and the prior-art date
gate_semantics.produces: immutable admission receipts; no score, selection or promotion

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: implementing agent; reviewer: an independent reviewer actor-independent from the author; verdict PASS, blocking_finding_count=0)

schema_binding.retrieval_surface: O05 plan and lane-receipt identities and RECEIPT_SCHEMA
